info.name: chocolate diary
info.description: A warm chocolate-brown Pinterest theme designed for a cozy, elegant browsing experience. Features creamy beige backgrounds, rich mocha accents, caramel details, soft rounded corners, and a clean aesthetic layout. Inspired by vintage coffee tones, minimalism, and the timeless chocolate-brown aesthetic.
